name: Sentry
summary: Sentry groups errors into issues, links them to releases and alerts on changes. The Developer plan is free for one user with 5,000 errors a month. Team costs $26 a month on annual billing for 50,000 errors, and Business at $80 adds SAML single sign-on.

facts.text: Sentry groups similar events into one issue based on a fingerprint, and a release marks an issue as a regression when newer events arrive after it was resolved.
An organization is created in either the US (Iowa) or the EU (Frankfurt), and the storage location cannot be changed afterwards.
Spike protection drops events when volume crosses a threshold based on past consumption, and events dropped this way are not charged.
Server-side scrubbing is on by default and removes card-like numbers and values whose keys contain words such as password, token or secret.
In the JavaScript SDK the error sample rate defaults to 1, which sends every error.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Billed annually; $29 on monthly billing. 50,000 errors a month, unlimited users, up to 90-day lookback

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Billed annually; $89 on monthly billing. 50,000 errors a month, SAML2 and SCIM, 14-day trial without a card

hiddenCosts: Events over the reserved quota are not accepted unless pay-as-you-go is set up, so a spike can leave a gap in data.
Logs and application metrics cost $0.50 per GB over the included 5 GB.
Uptime alerts cost $1.00 each and cron monitors $0.78 each beyond the plan allowance.
The Seer AI debugging agent is an extra cost on Team and above.

security.ssoPlan: Business for SAML2 and SCIM; Team has Google and GitHub sign-in
